source_state: working tree implementing continuation sinks and optional binding
machine: Apple M5 Max, arm64, macOS, 18 logical CPUs
conditions: three fresh processes per workload/mode; alternating mode order; serial measurements without concurrent builds or tests; desktop not isolated
sampling: 100 timed iterations plus 10 warmups for chain/fanin; 10 plus 3 for loops; one separate counted invocation per row. C++ new counts exclude direct malloc/mmap. OS peak RSS includes both row sizes and the whole process. Heap samples include stores, worker stacks and allocator retention. Compiling occurs outside timed/counted execution.
